name: Overload Voidbound Herb
tooltip:
Overload Voidbound Herb
5 yd range
5.3 sec cast
Herbs that have been saturated in the energies of the Void are particularly volatile and unpredictable. Overloading one furthers that volatility, resulting in a minor tear in reality. The resulting instability materializes shreds of herbs from other unknown locations nearby, which can be quickly gathered by agile herbalists before they disappear again.

One can also step through the tear if they so choose--who knows where they might end up?

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
